title: Card heading: what socios (AI agents) read to answer: pages, searches, datasets. "Grounded": used as the basis of an answer.
none: In place of the card's content while the analytics store has no numbers yet.
removed-space: In place of the name of a Space that was deleted. "Space" is a product noun.
removed-page: In place of the title of a page that was deleted.
kinds.turns: Label above a number: how many turns (answers from a socio) read something.
kinds.chats: Label above a number: in how many chats.
kinds.page: Each kinds.page…recall: a kind of reference, as a label above its count. Page reads: pages a socio read.
kinds.search: Pages that came up in a socio's page search.
kinds.context: The page open beside the chat while the socio answered.
kinds.recall: A socio looking back at earlier parts of the same chat.
kinds.in-turns: After a kind's count: in how many turns (answers from a socio).
heatmap.empty: In place of the heatmap when no pages were read. "Space" is a product noun.
heatmap.label: Accessible name of the scrolling heatmap of reads per Space over time.
heatmap.caption: Screen-reader caption of the heatmap table, one form per column's span (hour, day, week, month).
heatmap.space: Screen-reader column heading: the Space's name.
heatmap.reads: Column heading: total reads of the Space's pages.
heatmap.cell: Tooltip on a heatmap cell: {{space}} the Space's name, {{when}} the column's date, {{reads}} is heatmap.cell-reads.
heatmap.cell-reads: How many reads, in a heatmap cell's tooltip.
heatmap.pages: After a Space's reads: how many of its pages were read.
heatmap.chats: After a Space's reads: in how many chats.
heatmap.fewer: Heatmap legend: the light end of the color scale.
heatmap.more: Heatmap legend: the dark end of the color scale.
heatmap.top: After the legend when not every Space fits: {{shown}} Spaces shown, out of {{total}}.
pages.title: Heading of the table of pages that grounded (were read for) the most chats.
pages.space: Column heading: the Space (a shared area of pages; product noun) the page is in.
pages.chats: Column heading: in how many chats socios read the page.
pages.turns: Column heading: how many turns (answers from a socio) read the page.
pages.last: Column heading: when the page was last read by a socio.
